comment: Read at commit d55cb70. Twelve LightIds are configured in the enum and not one of them is ever written in process, and no LightWidget is added for any of them, so they can be neither seen nor clicked. Binary mode rounds the two signals before the four comparison outputs and the clip and fold outputs, but the six threshold gates read the unrounded signals, so binary mode changes half the panel and not the other half. cm_fold in CM_helpers.cpp gives up after fifty reflections and clamps what is left, and returns the lower threshold outright when the two thresholds are equal. Nothing here is polyphonic.
